title: Sync Labs Generation
description: A lip-sync video generation job in the Sync Labs platform

status.description: Current status of the generation job

created_at.description: Timestamp when the generation was submitted

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the generation completed (null if not yet finished)

video_url.description: URL to download the output lip-synced video (available when status is 'completed')

error.description: Error message if the generation failed

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the generated video in seconds

cost.description: Actual cost in USD charged for this generation
